text:
### 6. Fraud & AML Performance  
**Summary:**
Head of Financial Crime presented Q4 2025 fraud and AML metrics.  
**Fraud Metrics:**
- Fraud incidents: 5 (all detected and blocked)
- Fraud prevented: ~£47,000
- Customer reimbursement: £0 (all customers had zero liability)
- Detection rate: 97.1%  
**AML/KYC Metrics:**
- Customers screened: 180
- PEP matches: 2 (investigated, false positives)
- SARs filed: 3 (all compliant with timeline)
- High-risk accounts: 12 (under enhanced monitoring)  
**Committee Assessment:**
- Strong fraud prevention (97% detection rate)
- Effective AML controls (proactive SAR filing)
- No compliance violations detected
